title: Jawaharlal Nehru's birth chart
metaDescription: Jawaharlal Nehru's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.1° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Air dominates the certain ground here, taking five of the nine placements whose signs are settled. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 22.1° of Scorpio is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by the Moon in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 8.7° Scorpio, Venus holds 29.1° Libra, Mars holds 2.0° Libra — in the old shorthand, thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that begins as conversation; effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Saturn and Neptune hold the closest angle here — a square, 0.4° wide. The old texts treat a square as the aspect you feel earliest and thank latest: obstruction first, competence afterwards. Behind it, Mercury sextile Jupiter at 1.3°, and Mars trine Neptune at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Sun makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. Venus in Libra at 29.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Libra at 2.0° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Capricorn at 7.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 5 in air, 2 in water, 2 in earth by element, 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 2 fixed by modality. An air-weighted chart thinks in through-lines; the sentence is how it takes hold of the world. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Cancer into Leo during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.9° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
